label: r2c2
name: Dihedral layouts with DONE-first offset
hypothesis: This world may put DONE at index 0 and shift every placement by one, which the earlier layout hedges cannot catch. This net covers both offsets (DONE last, and DONE first with placements shifted), each over 8 type-major dihedral layouts, with one DONE head per offset. If it learns where the plain 8-layout net scored 0, the indices are shifted. If both seeds score 0, an offset is not the deviation.
